decision.ask: A task folder can hold both a page.jsonl and a task.jsonl — which one is the task's live log that an agent should follow()?

options.text: task.jsonl is the live log agents follow
options.say: task.jsonl is the live log agents follow
caveats: Not every task dir has one yet — 24 of 31 measured today do; a task that never ran the minion skill has none
options.caveat: Not every task dir has one yet — 24 of 31 measured today do; a task that never ran the minion skill has none

options.text: page.jsonl is the live log agents follow
options.say: page.jsonl is the live log agents follow
caveats: Its lines are dashboard chrome for the owner (class, message, file pointers), not an agent-usable record of steps and decisions
options.caveat: Its lines are dashboard chrome for the owner (class, message, file pointers), not an agent-usable record of steps and decisions

decision.why: task.jsonl is the one a minion actually writes to while working (assign, log, decision, step) and what a fresh agent resumes from; page.jsonl is the ai2 dashboard card's own log for the owner, and mostly just points at task.jsonl with a file line
